policy.title: Escalation rule
policy.description: Who gets the lead first, and who gets it next if nobody acknowledges in time.

level.timeoutInvalid: Enter a time of at least one second.

repeat.label: Rounds
repeat.helper: How many times the whole chain runs before the lead is flagged critical.

end.label: At the end of the chain
end.body: The lead is flagged critical, the fallback owner is alerted even if offline, and routing keeps retrying.

hours.note: Rules run around the clock. Business-hours rules are planned.

test.title: Test this rule
test.description: Runs a pretend lead through the draft using today's team availability. Nothing is saved or sent.

assignment.title: Assignment settings
assignment.description: How new leads are shared out inside a team.

mode.label: How leads are shared
mode.round_robinHint: Leads go to the next available person in turn, skipping anyone at capacity.
mode.first_to_claimHint: Every available person is offered the lead; the first to claim it owns it.
mode.flagOff: Turn on the feature flag to use this.

capacity.label: Open leads per person
capacity.helper: A person at this number is skipped until they free up capacity.

retry.label: Retry interval
retry.helper: When nobody is available, how often routing tries again.

idle.label: Re-trigger idle leads
idle.helper: If an acknowledged lead sees no action, send it back into routing.
idle.flagOff: This behaviour is behind a feature flag that is currently off.

assignment.ackNote: The first acknowledgement window is {time}. Change it as the first level of the escalation rule.
